correctness.rationale: For the source remainder family, \(w_{\beta,\tau}=x_d^{-\beta}(x_d/R)^\tau\) with \(0<x_d/R\le1\). Thus \(w_{\beta,\tau_2}\le w_{\beta,\tau_1}\) for \(\tau_2\ge\tau_1\). A positive source constant at any smaller admissible exponent therefore remains valid at every larger exponent. Since each source theorem provides positive constants on a nonempty interval starting at zero, every \(\tau>0\) is covered. The same order argument proves monotonicity of the best constants.
risks: The result concerns only this ordered remainder family and does not determine the sharp numerical constants.
